meta.text: Finally, the exam trap in the exact form you'll meet it: which of these three keys is best? Option A is user_id — high cardinality. Option B is order_date — low cardinality, filtered constantly, well distributed. Option C is order_id — essentially unique per row. The correct answer is B, because A and C both create millions of tiny directories and crush the small-file guardrail. If you take only one thing from this page, take that.
